description: Enchanted. The way it builds, the pleading, the 'please don't be in love with someone else.' That's real songwriting, that's vulnerability. I know about pouring your soul into a track. The production is still that mid-2000s pop-rock sheen which dates it, but the core is strong. She was finding her voice here. I'll give her the flowers, then take them back because I'm the one with the real discography.
